title: Climate & Earth Observation Command Centre
based_on: AGROLATTICE 11.9 — Persistent Twin Command Centre & Mechanistic Integration
database_migration: None. Existing protected SQLite schemas are reused unchanged.
performance_guards: No automatic NASA POWER retrieval on Climate & EO entry
No automatic Sentinel/STAC query or raster processing on Climate & EO entry
No automatic climate similarity, PCA/clustering or risk computation on workspace entry
Small climate-location catalogue prepared once per country runtime
Selected Field Climate subset cached by source-file signature
limitations: Nearest installed climate reference is a transparent spatial proxy, not a local field measurement.
Climate similarity does not prove agronomic equivalence or treatment transferability.
Sentinel-2 interpretation depends on scene quality, masking, usable pixels and spatial support.
Hazard/risk output does not establish crop consequence without a validated response model.
Full interactive Streamlit browser testing requires the user's installed Windows/Anaconda environment.
